original.statement: The `ciss` short name was added for the `ClusterIssuer` resource, allowing kubectl access via the shorter alias.

decision.reason: [ev-41698084a48b] only says a `ciss` short name was added for the ClusterIssuer resource. Nothing in it says an existing configuration fails or changes. The validators confirm that cert-manager.io/v1 ClusterIssuer exists in both releases [ev-60054fcf0986][ev-9b6164ce0df7], so this is an extra alias on an existing kind. Limiting relevance to environments that use ClusterIssuer (gvk-in-use cert-manager.io/v1 ClusterIssuer) fits this informational, no-impact note. The evidence names no environment state that would justify a broader or narrower condition, such as a short-name clash with another CRD.
